beats.what: 01453 leaves Hadapsar Mondays from Oct 19 to Nov 23. 01481 leaves Tuesdays from Oct 20 to Nov 24.
beats.why: Lakhs travel home to Bihar and UP for Diwali and Chhath, and regular trains fill fast.
